# DGrowthR: A comprehensive workflow for growth curve analysis

![](assets/Logo-DGrowthR.png)

This repository hosts the `DGrowthR` R package and the workflow for the
detailed analysis of publicly available datasets mentioned in our
pre-print. This workflow is designed to showcase the application of the
`DGrowthR` package to model complex, non-linear dynamics of bacterial
growth using Gaussian Process Regression.

![](assets/dgrowthr_panel.png)

> \[!TIP\] For more details, check out our pre-print [Statistical
> end-to-end analysis of large-scale microbial growth data with
> DGrowthR](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.03.25.645164v2)
> on bioRxiv.
>
> DGrowthR is also available as a **standalone Desktop-App** for Windows
> and Apple (<https://zenodo.org/records/15118187>).

## Installation Guide

To install the `DGrowthR` R package directly from this repository. First
make sure you clone the repository and enter into the cloned folder.
Then you can execute the following commands in R.

1.  Ensure that you have the `devtools` package installed. If not, you
    can install it using the following command

``` r
# Install devtools
install.packages("devtools")

# Load the library
library(devtools)
```

2.  Use the `install` function to install the `DGrowthR` package:

``` r
install()
```

Additionally, you must install the
[permApprox](https://github.com/stefpeschel/permApprox) package in order
to obtain gamma-approximated p-values.

``` r
remotes::install_github("stefpeschel/permApprox")
```

## How to use `DGrowthR`.

An overview of the main functionalities of `DGrowthR` with concrete
examples can be found in our [tutorial
vignette](https://github.com/bio-datascience/DGrowthR/blob/main/vignettes/DGrowthR.Rmd)

## Analysis workflow.

Additionally, you see our analysis of publicly available datasets from
the [Brochado 2018](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-018-0278-9)
and [Brenzinger
2024](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41564-023-01556-y) studies.

All steps are in our
[workflow](https://github.com/bio-datascience/DGrowthR/tree/main/workflow)
folder

# Package index

## All functions

- [`DGrowthR-class`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/DGrowthR-class.md)
  [`DGrowthR`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/DGrowthR-class.md)
  : This S4 class represents a DGrowthR model.
- [`DGrowthRFromData()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/DGrowthRFromData.md)
  : Instiantiate a DGrowthR object.
- [`alternative()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/alternative.md)
  : Accessor for the alternative slot
- [`calculate_emp_p_value()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/calculate_emp_p_value.md)
  : Calculate the Empirical p_value
- [`clustering()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/clustering.md)
  : Clustering Function
- [`estimate_fpca()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/estimate_fpca.md)
  : Functional Principal Component Analysis
- [`estimate_growth_parameters()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/estimate_growth_parameters.md)
  : Estimate growth parameters
- [`estimate_umap()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/estimate_umap.md)
  : Functional UMAP
- [`example_metadata`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/example_metadata.md)
  : Example DGrowthR Metadata
- [`example_od_data`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/example_od_data.md)
  : Example DGrowthR Optical Density Data
- [`fit_predict_gp()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/fit_predict_gp.md)
  : Fit at GP model and predict the mean process
- [`gamma_pvalues()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/gamma_pvalues.md)
  : Gamma approximated pvalues
- [`gather_od_data()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/gather_od_data.md)
  : Gather specific growth data from the DGrowthR object
- [`growth_comparison()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/growth_comparison.md)
  : Predict the values of the fitted model to an object.
- [`growth_comparison_result()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/growth_comparison_result.md)
  : Accessor for the result of growth comparison
- [`lrt_statistic()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/lrt_statistic.md)
  : Accessor for the likelihood ratio test result
- [`multiple_comparisons()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/multiple_comparisons.md)
  : Multiple Comparisons
- [`null()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/null.md)
  : Accessor for the null slot
- [`perm_test()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/perm_test.md)
  : Perform a permutation test for the DGrowthR object
- [`perm_test_result()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/perm_test_result.md)
  : Accessor for the perm_test_result slot
- [`plot_fpca()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_fpca.md)
  : Plot FPCAs
- [`plot_gp()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_gp.md)
  : Plot Gaussian Process
- [`plot_growth_comparison()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_growth_comparison.md)
  : Plot Growth Comparison
- [`plot_growth_curves()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_growth_curves.md)
  : Plot Optical Density
- [`plot_likelihood_ratio()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_likelihood_ratio.md)
  : Plot Likelihood Ratios
- [`plot_od_difference()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_od_difference.md)
  : Plot Optical Density over Time
- [`plot_umap()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/plot_umap.md)
  : Plot UMAP components
- [`preprocess_data()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/preprocess_data.md)
  : Preprocess Growth Data
- [`read_individual_plate()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/read_individual_plate.md)
  : Read individual growth plate
- [`read_multiple_plates()`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/read_multiple_plates.md)
  : Read a collection growth plate data.
- [`show(`*`<DGrowthR>`*`)`](https://bio-datascience.github.io/DGrowthR/reference/show-DGrowthR-method.md)
  : Display a summary of the DGrowthR object
